title.en: Assembly layer reveal with stable identities

summary: Reveal nested parts while retaining their original attachment, identity and recoverable assembled pose.
objective: Reveal nested parts while retaining their original attachment, identity and recoverable assembled pose.
example_prompts: Use assembly layer reveal with stable identities for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Choose layer separation for depth relationships and an exploded layout for part relationships.
Presentation offsets should not rewrite the original mechanical or anatomical model.
implementation: Store original part transforms, parent IDs and selection IDs before revealing layers.
Offset only the presentation nodes; add restrained connection guides where attachments become ambiguous.
Keep a whole-object thumbnail or restore action available during close inspection.
observable_checks: Reset restores all original transforms and selected part identity.
A selected label continues to identify the same part throughout the reveal.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
